title: Release v4.4.0 - Work Contributions, Follow-Ups & Shareholder Equity Subsystem
tagline: AI-powered WhatsApp chat drop, multi-factor evaluation engine, in-progress follow-up radar, and shareholder equity profit distribution.

features: Work Contribution & Shareholder Equity Subsystem in Django backend (/api/populate/read/work_contribution, /create, /update, /delete)
WhatsApp-style Quick Work Status AI Ingress (/contributions/add) extracting activities, scopes, categories, and points from raw text
Deterministic 6-Factor Quality & Impact Evaluation Engine (Effort 20%, Skill 15%, Deliverable 25%, Quality 20%, Evidence 10%, Outcome 10%)
In-Progress Work Follow-Up Lifecycle Engine (/contributions/follow-ups) tracking stalled tasks (>48h) and unlocking remaining 25% points upon completion
Executive Contribution & Shareholder Dashboard (/contributions/dashboard) with 3-way comparative tables (Project, Company, Combined) and live profit pool simulator
Multi-dimensional Filterable Reports & Granular Audit Ledger (/contributions/reports) with single-entry detail view and CSV export
improvements: Database seeder command (seed_contributions) initializing 58 contribution categories, 6 evaluation factors, and baseline company entries
Pure page-only routing architecture (/contributions/dashboard, /add, /follow-ups, /reports) complying with platform laws
Added module documentation in knowledge_brain/Contributions/MODULE_BRAIN.md and indexed alphabetically in knowledge_brain/INDEX.md
security: Server-side immutable point and factor calculations in WorkContributionService preventing client-side point manipulation
Strict ABAC policy enforcement with platform-wide transparency for shareholder equity calculations
